personal.name: Md. Khalid Hasan
personal.intro: Turning spatial data into meaningful insights through GIS, remote sensing and photogrammetry.
personal.about:
I’m Md. Khalid Hasan, a Dhaka-based GIS professional and Junior Photogrammetrist at The Decode Ltd. My work focuses on stereo digitization, 3D feature extraction and spatial data quality, using aerial and satellite imagery to create reliable geospatial information.

My academic background is in Geography and Environment at Dhaka College. Through my work with CEGIS, GMGI and GPAD, I have gained experience in land-use mapping, image interpretation, topology validation and GIS support for planning. I work with ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap and DAT/EM Summit Evolution, and I am interested in land-cover change, environmental research and the connection between field observations and mapped data.
